# infrawrench_probe (Resource)

An HTTP check run from the edge against a URL, which flips to `down` after enough consecutive failures and raises a `probeAlerts` notification.

A probe is what `infrawrench_status_page` puts on a public page, so the two go together: the probe decides what is checked, the page decides what the public is told about it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "infrawrench_probe" "api" {
  name = "API health"
  url  = "https://api.example.com/health"

  # Clamped server-side to 60–86400; stay inside the range or the stored value
  # will differ from the configured one on every plan.
  interval_seconds  = 60
  failure_threshold = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Internal name. The public page can show a different label.
- `url` (String) Absolute `http(s)` URL the check hits.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) A paused probe keeps its history and stops checking.
- `failure_threshold` (Number) Consecutive failures before the probe flips to `down` and notifies. Clamped server-side to 1–20.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between checks. Clamped server-side to 60–86400, so a value outside that range is stored as the nearest bound rather than rejected — which would read as permanent drift against the configuration. Keep it in range.
- `method` (String) One of `GET`, `HEAD`, `OPTIONS`. Defaults to `GET`.
- `output_key` (String) The resource output or field key the URL was taken from. Create-only, like `resource_id`.
- `resource_id` (String) Link the probe to the Infrawrench resource whose output the URL came from — use `data.infrawrench_resources` to resolve one. Advisory rather than a foreign key, and recorded at creation only: the update route does not carry it, so changing it replaces the probe.
- `timeout_ms` (Number) Per-check timeout in milliseconds. Clamped server-side to 1000–60000.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Account of the linked resource, when the URL came from one.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned probe id. Use it with `terraform import`.
- `status` (String) `unknown` until the first result, `down` after `failure_threshold` consecutive failures, `up` on any success.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id is in the URL when you open the object in the app, and in the
# --json output of the Infrawrench CLI.
terraform import infrawrench_probe.example 7d8e9f0a-1b2c-3d4e-5f6a-7b8c9d0e1f2a
```
